articles.title: Venezuela Releases Political Prisoners as Calls for Elections Grow
articles.summary: Venezuelan authorities freed a group of political prisoners Saturday, human rights groups say, days after interim President Delcy Rodríguez met President Trump in New York. Opposition figures are now demanding free elections.

articles.title: The 'Wild West' of AI in Schools: A Chatbot Named Jordan and a $78,650 Experiment
articles.summary: A Dayton, Ohio, school paid $78,650 this year for AI tools, including a moody chatbot named Jordan that asks students for advice. Research on AI in classrooms is extremely limited, a Stanford review found.

articles.title: Maine's Senate Race Tests Whether Voters Still Care About Collins' Kavanaugh Vote
articles.summary: Senator Susan Collins faces her first election since the Supreme Court overturned Roe v. Wade. Her 2018 vote for Justice Kavanaugh is central to the race, but other issues may matter more to Maine voters.
